threshold_proximity_rule.statement: a discrete outcome (reason, status, boolean, settling sample index, None-ness) derived from a toleranced continuous quantity x by a threshold test x vs theta may differ between the implementations only where the Python value lies within x's registered tolerance of theta: |x_py - theta| <= tol(x_py) (combined with the threshold's own relative slack). Such a difference is recorded NOT_SCORED_AT_THRESHOLD with the quantity, theta and both values; any other difference fails. The dependent outcomes (status from reasons, objectives None-ness, the values that are masked or offered only on one side) of that vector are then not scored either and are listed

quantities.R_CHARACTERISTIC: K_min vs 1 - K_TOL; K_over_K0_max vs 1 + K_TOL
quantities.R_STAGE_DOMAIN: p_stage_max vs P_DOMAIN_PA (1 + 1e-12); compressor inlet pressure vs P_DOMAIN_PA
quantities.R_BISECTION: bisection_residual_rel vs BISECT_RTOL; a_eq vs the bracket ends (1 -/+ 1e-9)
quantities.R_SATURATED / saturated_end: u_cmd at the segment end vs 1 + 1e-9 and -1e-9 (tolerance: the u tolerance); orbit_quasi_static u_max vs 1
quantities.R_NOT_SETTLED / settling index: per sample |y - y_final| vs SETTLE_BAND |y_final| (tolerance: twice the trajectory tolerance of y, relative to |y_final|)
quantities.reservoir converged / bracketed: not toleranced: EXACT_VALUE without exception (identical algorithm)

v3_transient.statement: for P42 / P43 / P45 the v1 transient quantities are replaced as below; each differing discrete leaf must be attributed to a flagged governing quantity of the same segment (no vector-wide excuse); a difference without its flag fails

quantities.settling_time_s / flow_recovery_s / sett: some sample j with | |y_j - y_f| - band |y_f| | <= tol(y_j) + tol(y_f), y = p (final = the setpoint, tol(y_f) = 0) or mdot (final = the last sample), tol = (E_py + E_rust)[F42.p] r0 or [F42.mdot] mdot_scale, band = SETTLE_BAND (P43 uses the P42 sample envelopes of the same level)
quantities.R_CHARACTERISTIC / R_STAGE_DOMAIN / R_TH: the image interval (ill_conditioned_diagnostics, 8 corners) of the governing quantity (min K_min vs 1 - K_TOL, max K_over_K0_max vs 1 + K_TOL, max p_stage_max_Pa vs P_DOMAIN_PA (1 + 1e-12), max p_inlet_max_Pa vs P_DOMAIN_PA, T_comp_max_K vs T_comp_limit_K) contains or touches theta
quantities.xO None-ness (P42 sample j): |u_py,j| <= (E_py + E_rust)[F42.u] (xO is undefined exactly where the valve opening is not positive; the sign of u inside its envelope is unresolved)
quantities.P43: transient_case does not return samples: its proximity tolerances use the P42 envelopes of the same level (same event sequence and integrators) on the instrumented Python samples
quantities.dependent outcomes: R_SATURATED / R_NOT_SETTLED from the flagged leaves above, status from reasons, objectives.settling_max_s None-ness and value from the settling leaves
quantities.not toleranced (EXACT_VALUE without exce: ok, R_INTEGRATOR, R_CONSERVATION (both residuals are rounding-level against MASS_TOL 1e-6), R_DEADHEAD / NO_STEADY_START (closed-form steady network), event / kind / state ids

v3_transient.counting: the proximity limit counts discrete leaves: NOT_SCORED_AT_THRESHOLD leaves (governing and dependent) over the EXACT_VALUE leaves compared in the entry (the v1 text 'scored discrete outcomes'; the v1 / v2 harness counted vectors, which made one coincidence among 17 vectors exceed 1 %)

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, enums, booleans, statuses, reasons, ids, error classes, None / null, list lengths and orders, dict key SETS (Python dict insertion order carries no meaning in these records and is not compared), and floats that are copied (not computed): equal (floats by value, -0.0 == 0.0; non-finite floats are transported as the strings 'NaN', '+inf', '-inf' and compared as strings)
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp * ulp(py) OR |rust - py| <= r_rel * |py| OR |rust - py| <= a_abs, k_ulp / r_rel / a_abs fixed per observable group below (an absent clause is not applied); relative clause scaled by |py| (not max(1, |py|)): the observables span 1e-30 .. 1e9. ulp(py) = math.ulp(py)
tolerance_classes.SOLVER_TOLERANCE: convergence / solver status EXACT_VALUE; solution |rust - py| <= abs_tol + rel_tol * |py| with abs_tol / rel_tol fixed per entry below and tied to the solver's own tolerance; iteration and function-evaluation counts reported, not scored
tolerance_classes.EXACT_STREAM: not used (no RNG in either implementation)
tolerance_classes.CONVERGENCE_ENVELOPE: A9.31 sec. 5: |rust - py| <= (E_py + E_rust) x s + max(k_ulp ulp(py), r_rel |py|) with E_py / E_rust the frozen numerical-discretisation envelopes of the two implementations (envelope record, estimated on the independent refinement grid before the held-out vectors are run), s the registered family scale and (k_ulp 4, r_rel 1e-9) the existing floating residual allowance of the steady network class (v1 tolerance_basis.closed_form_and_steady). Non-finite values compare as strings (EXACT_VALUE)

registered.closed_form_and_steady: the Rust port repeats the reference operation order; scalar Python floats and glibc libm are reproduced exactly; the reference's numpy paths (area_for_pressure exp, steady_sweep, cascade_arrays, orbit sin) may differ by a few ulp (AVX512 SIMD loops); the cascade throughput Q = (A_c p2 - p3) / B_c can cancel and amplify that by up to ~1e6, so r_rel 1e-9 is the registered bound

registered.transient: v3: no tolerance is chosen; the transient tolerances are the convergence-derived envelopes of transient_convergence_procedure_v3, frozen in the envelope record before the held-out vectors are run (A9.31 sec. 5). The v1 statement (100 x the integrator rtol) is withdrawn for v3

transient_convergence_procedure_v3.authority: A9.31 sec. 5, binding word for word (docs/decisions/OD_2026_10_06_A9_31_NEXT_BATCH_OWNER_RULINGS_AND_ARCHITECTURE_PROOF.md, Message 1 sec. 5 (text sha256 ab7705efeb0835b9443cebd86018cd5c29bdbc3f29d6f618c147dab1e7dec75a)): 'Do NOT choose an arbitrary owner tolerance. Use a preregistered convergence-derived tolerance procedure' (steps 1-6 below map one to one onto the ruling's steps 1-6)

PROD.rust_method: Radau IIA order 5 (DIV-P-01; v4 switching-point fix, v6 growing-mode guard)
PROD.vectors: P42 / P43 PROD vectors (module defaults) and every P45 vector

REF.rust_method: Radau IIA order 5 (DIV-P-01; v4 switching-point fix, v6 growing-mode guard)
REF.vectors: P42 / P43 REF vectors (rtol RTOL_REFERENCE, method INTEGRATOR_REFERENCE)

tolerance_levels.rule: a tightened run changes rtol only: same implementation and method, same atol (ATOL_SCALED 1e-11 on the scaled states), same t_eval sample grid, same event sequence and inputs

override_mechanics.python: P42 / P43: the rtol / method arguments of TransientRun / transient_case; P45: orbit_simulated has no rtol argument, so the harness sets the default rtol of TransientRun.__init__ in its own process for the tightened P45 runs only (no reference file is changed; the nominal P45 runs use the unmodified default)
override_mechanics.rust: P42 / P43: the request 'rtol'; P45: a request carrying 'rtol' is evaluated by the parity CLI as TransientRun::new(rtol) + steady_start + run + the orbit_simulated record (library calls only); check COMP-P-01: at the nominal rtol this composed path equals the library orbit_simulated byte for byte on every P45 refinement vector (recorded in the envelope record; a mismatch voids the record)

step_1_refinement_grid.statement: an independent development / refinement grid of transient cases, separate from the held-out scored vectors, frozen by this contract
step_1_refinement_grid.generator: the held-out P42 / P43 / P45 draw procedure verbatim (inputs.randomized_domain.draw: transients, P45) with larger counts; no edge vectors
step_1_refinement_grid.frozen_as: the envelope record stores the sha256 of the canonical JSON of the grid inputs

transient_convergence_procedure_v3.step_2_runs: every refinement vector is run by both implementations at its level's nominal, T1 and T2 rtol (six runs per vector). Python is the read-only reference module at python_commit; Rust is the abep-gaspath-parity CLI at the recorded commit

step_3_envelope_estimator.per_leaf: e = (|x_N - x_T2| + |x_T1 - x_T2|) / s_F, all three values from the same implementation. |x_N - x_T2| estimates the nominal discretisation error; |x_T1 - x_T2| bounds the residual error of T2 (convergence with decreasing rtol, verified by the Python-only disclosure above), so e bounds |x_N - x_exact| / s_F
step_3_envelope_estimator.envelope: E[impl, level, entry, family] = the maximum of e over every pairable leaf of the family over every refinement vector of that entry and level. No multiplier or coverage factor is applied (one would be a chosen tolerance). Exchangeability note (recorded, not a rule): with n refinement and m held-out vectors of one entry and level drawn from the same distribution, the chance that the held-out maximum of one implementation's error exceeds the grid maximum is m / (n + m) (1.5 % for P42 / P43 PROD (12 / 780) and REF (4 / 260), 0.8 % for P45 (4 / 516)); the decision adds the other implementation's envelope and the floating allowance
step_3_envelope_estimator.pairable: a leaf is pairable when it is a finite float in all three runs of the implementation (xO: finite, i.e. defined, in all three); a run that is refused, fails (ok false, MODEL_ERROR) or differs in structure from its T2 run (segment / metric count, None-ness) contributes no leaf of that vector and is listed in the record (with the discrete N-vs-T2 differences); if a family has no pairable leaf its envelope is NOT_EVALUATED and every held-out leaf of it fails

scales.r0: the vector's design setpoint r0 [Pa] (an input)
scales.mdot_scale: TransientRun(filter, plant, plenum, controller, design intake, r0).mdot_scale of the reference: sum_s c_s a_ss p_s m_s / (k T) at the design steady state [kg/s], a closed-form property of the vector computed once by the harness and used for both implementations (a relative scale, not an absolute floor)
scales.1: dimensionless (valve opening, mole fraction, setpoint-relative fractions)
scales.relative: |x_T2| of the same implementation on the grid; |py| at scoring

F42.p.leaves: segments[*].p[*] (total plenum pressure at every registered sample time)

F42.xO.leaves: segments[*].xO[*] where finite in every run compared

F42.ucmd_end.leaves: segments[*]._ucmd_end (reported, not scored; proximity tolerance of saturated_end)

step_3_envelope_estimator.levels: every family is estimated separately for PROD and REF (P45: PROD only) and for each implementation
also_recorded_not_used: T2-vs-T2 cross-implementation difference per family (model-equivalence diagnostic, not a verdict)
max |T1 - T2| / max |N - T2| per family (convergence ratio)
N - T2 relative differences of the six segment cascade diagnostics (their ill-conditioning)
CONS-P-03 mass residuals of every run
COMP-P-01 (P45 composed path equals the library orbit_simulated at nominal rtol)

step_4_freeze.content: contract id and sha256, refinement inputs sha256, python_commit and environment, rust commit and build provenance, harness sha256, the envelopes E[impl, level, entry, family] with the vector and leaf attaining each maximum, counts, failures and the also_recorded items
step_4_freeze.rule: committed in its own commit before any held-out (scoring_master_seed) vector is generated or run; the scoring run refuses unless the record exists, is tracked and unchanged since its commit, names this contract's sha256 and has no NOT_EVALUATED envelope it needs; the report records its sha256 and commit. The record is never edited after the scoring run

transient_convergence_procedure_v3.step_5_score: the held-out P42 / P43 / P45 vectors are scored on the common physical observables at the registered physical sample times: the module t_eval grid of every event (0 plus 150 geometric points from 1e-6 max(T, 1) to T, deduplicated, last = T; identical in both implementations and ULP-checked), and the segment metrics, extrema, final values, summary and objectives defined on those samples
transient_convergence_procedure_v3.step_6_decision: for every family leaf: |rust - py| <= (E_py + E_rust) x s_F + max(4 ulp(py), 1e-9 |py|) at the vector's level (CONVERGENCE_ENVELOPE); the floating term is the existing STEADY floating residual allowance
transient_convergence_procedure_v3.not_scored: nfev, internal step / segment decomposition, iteration counts (A9.31 sec. 5); mass_residual_rel (gated per implementation, CONS-P-03); _ucmd_end (proximity input)

ill_conditioned_diagnostics.quantities: P42 segments[*]: K_min, K_over_K0_max, p_stage_max_Pa, P_el_max_W, T_comp_max_K (the forward Gaede cascade along the trajectory: K = K0 - (K0 - 1) Q / (S p), Q = (A_c p2 - p3) / B_c) and p_inlet_max_Pa (p2 = (f d + beta p3) / (e + alpha), linear in the states)
ill_conditioned_diagnostics.rule_cascade: K_min, K_over_K0_max, p_stage_max_Pa, P_el_max_W, T_comp_max_K: scored through their well-conditioned primitives and reported with the conditioning recorded, not scored as cross-implementation values: (a) the per-species plenum states that determine them are the scored samples of F42.p (total) and F42.xO (composition) at the registered sample times; (b) the map is scored on identical inputs by P35 (CompressorPlant.cascade) and P40 (segment_metrics / _domain_reasons) of this contract, and IMG-CHECK confirms the instrumented reference map reproduces the reported values bit for bit; (c) the domain decisions they feed (R_CHARACTERISTIC, R_STAGE_DOMAIN, R_THERMAL in transient_case) are EXACT_VALUE under the image proximity rule (threshold_proximity_rule.v3_transient)
ill_conditioned_diagnostics.rule_inlet: p_inlet_max_Pa: allowed |rust - py| = W + max(4 ulp(py), 1e-9 |py|), W = max over the 8 corners sigma in {-1, +1}^3 of |f(y + sigma delta) - f(y)|, y the Python nominal scaled plenum states at the registered sample times, delta = E_py + E_rust of F42.p at the vector's level, f the reference TransientRun._segment_record on the perturbed states
ill_conditioned_diagnostics.conditioning_recorded: per segment and quantity: f(y), W (the envelope image, delta box), W_round (the image of the 4-ulp box y_s (1 +/- 4 eps)) and kappa = W / (delta |f|), kappa_round = W_round / (4 eps |f|): kappa_round >> 1 marks a value whose computed digits are rounding noise
ill_conditioned_diagnostics.image_also_used_by: the threshold-proximity rule of the cascade domain reasons (image interval of the delta box, 8 corners), unchanged from v3 / v4
ill_conditioned_diagnostics.check: IMG-CHECK: f(y) equals the Python reported value bit for bit (the instrumentation reproduces the reference)

transient_convergence_procedure_v3.no_tighter_rust_integration: the Rust integrator is the v1 Radau IIA (DIV-P-01) with the registered switching-point fix (rust_implementation.v4_rust_defect_fix) and the growing-mode guard (rust_implementation.v6_rust_defect_fix); its error norm, rtol / atol and output grid are unchanged; no tighter internal integration is registered
transient_convergence_procedure_v3.version_note: the procedure registered in contract v3, carried into v4-v7 (section name kept); v5 changed ill_conditioned_diagnostics and the grid counts; v6 the registered Rust integrator; v7 replaces step_1 (draws) and step_4.record by transient_convergence_procedure_v7 and applies steps 3, 5 and 6 per stratum

transient_convergence_procedure_v7.authority: A9.31 sec. 1 (supersession before any scored run) and sec. 5 (convergence-derived envelopes); coordinator decisions 2026-10-07 (v6 superseded unscored; v7 design approved with additions)
transient_convergence_procedure_v7.applies_to: P42 transient_run, P43 transient_case, P45 orbit_simulated (every other entry: the v1 / v3 rules)
transient_convergence_procedure_v7.replaces_in_v3_section: step_1_refinement_grid (draws) and step_4_freeze.record (path); steps 2, 3, 5, 6, tolerance levels, families and scales are used per stratum as below

stability_class.input_property: computed from the vector's inputs only (no transient run)

equilibria.P42 / P43: one per event of the fixed sequence event_sequence(design, r0, window_s) (E0 hold, E1 / E2 setpoint x1.1 and back, E3 / E4 feed path x0.8 and back, E5 / E6 / E7 supply x0.9, x1.1, back): the equilibrium of the event's intake, setpoint, density and feed factor
equilibria.P45: the orbit event's quasi-static equilibria at density 1 + amplitude sin(2 pi k / 24), k = 0..23 (the reference orbit_quasi_static default phase grid n_phase = 24); k = 0 is the steady start

stability_class.equilibrium: co = Chain(event intake, filter, plant, plenum).node_coefficients(density); (A, ok) = area_for_pressure(co, setpoint, k_rec, leak, feed); CLOSING if not ok (the setpoint is at or above the dead-head pressure: the valve closes); u = A / (A_max feed_factor); SAT_OPEN if u > 1; else UNSAT with y = (p_s / r0 from solve_pressures(co, A, ...), u, I = (u / u_ff - 1) Ti / Kp, 0, 0, 0) and the eigenvalues of the dynamic 5 x 5 block (scaled pressures, valve opening, integral) of the reference Jacobian TransientRun._make(event) at y (the three cumulative-integral states have zero Jacobian columns)
stability_class.class: U if some UNSAT equilibrium has an eigenvalue with Re lambda > 0 (no other threshold); R if the vector is refused (TransientRun at the design setpoint raises ValueError: dead-head; P45 also no steady start: y0 None or u_ss > 1); S otherwise
stability_class.implementations: Python: the harness on the reference module's own functions (TransientRun, Chain.node_coefficients, area_for_pressure, solve_pressures, TransientRun._make Jacobian) with numpy.linalg.eigvals; Rust: parity CLI plenum.stability_class (TransientRun::event_equilibrium, eig_real; rust_implementation.v7_stability_class)
stability_class.agreement: every held-out transient vector (incl. R) has a scored class vector '<id>#class': class and per-equilibrium kind EXACT_VALUE; a disagreement is a scored FAILURE, never an exclusion; Re lambda_max is reported, not scored. The stratum of a held-out vector is the Python class (the class used by the draw)
stability_class.unclean_vectors_rule: the class is defined by the equilibria only. A vector whose equilibria are all stable but whose trajectory passes linearly unstable states between equilibria is S (scored under the S envelopes, which are estimated over S vectors including such cases). For P45 the 24 quasi-static phases cover the orbit: v5 R45-021 (stable at the steady start, -7.3e-4 +/- 0.225i, unstable along its orbit) is U (9 of 24 phases with Re lambda > 0, max 1.9e-3); v6 R45-393 is U (max 4.9e-4). P42 / P43: v6 R43-PROD-033 (stable at E0, unstable at E1 / E5) is U

strata.S: stable: Rust N vs Python N, bound (E_py^S + E_rust^S) x s_F + max(4 ulp(py), 1e-9 |py|), the v3 rules (step_5 / step_6, proximity) with the S envelopes
strata.U: unstable: Rust N vs the converged Python reference T2 (DIV-P-REF-01: the Python nominal transient is not trustworthy on unstable loops), unstable_stratum below
strata.R: refused: domain / error parity (the v1 rules); no envelope

unstable_stratum.reference: Python T2 run (rtol T2 of the vector's level; P45 by the registered default-rtol override); the Python N and T1 runs are evaluated before it and recorded (the instrumentation keeps the T2 run)
unstable_stratum.float_leaf_bound: |x_rust,N - x_py,T2| <= (E_rust^U + D_py^U) x s_F + max(4 ulp(x_py,T2), 1e-9 |x_py,T2|); E_rust^U = max over the U refinement leaves of (|y_N - y_T2| + |y_T1 - y_T2|) / s_F (Rust runs), D_py^U = max over the same leaves of |x_T1 - x_T2| / s_F (the converged reference's own change), both over leaves whose reference is convergent
unstable_stratum.scale: the registered family scales, except F45.P_dev in U: relative, s = |x_py,T2| (the outcome: a held answer, P_dev about 0, cannot pass because the bound is checked < 1)
unstable_stratum.not_convergent_reference: a float leaf of the Python reference is NOT_CONVERGENT_REFERENCE when rho = |x_T1 - x_T2| / |x_N - x_T1| >= 1/2 (with f = max(4 ulp(x_T2), 1e-9 |x_T2|): |x_N - x_T1| <= f and |x_T1 - x_T2| <= f is convergent; |x_N - x_T1| <= f < |x_T1 - x_T2| is not), or when it is missing / of another type in N or T1; a discrete leaf when T1 != T2. Such leaves are reported (with the Python and Rust values), neither scored nor counted as a pass, and excluded from E_rust^U / D_py^U. rho_limit 1/2: a convergent tolerance sequence contracts by orders of magnitude (median rho of the v6 unstable leaves 4.5e-3); 1/2 marks a second tightening that changes the value at least half as much as the first (v6 R45-034 rho 0.99; the rest of its P45 class <= 0.35)
unstable_stratum.discrete_leaves: EXACT_VALUE against the Python T2 output under the v3 proximity rule with the U bounds and the T2 samples
unstable_stratum.sampled_extrema: extrema sampled from a limit cycle (P_dev_max_frac, mdot_min / mdot_max, xO / u / p extrema, valve travel) are phase-sensitive where the reference is not convergent; they are then NOT_CONVERGENT_REFERENCE leaves, labelled so in the report

closing_valve_xO.proximity_counting: P42 xO None-ness differences that the v3 proximity rule excuses (|u_py,j| <= bound of F42.u) count as ONE NOT_SCORED_AT_THRESHOLD leaf per (vector, segment) in decision_rules.proximity_limit; every excused sample is reported. Reason: while the valve is shut (a closing-valve segment, or a transient closure in which the opening decays to rounding level) the governing quantity is a single one, the sign of the segment's rounding-level valve opening, and the None-ness of all its samples follows it; counting each sample would turn one threshold coincidence into many and make the limit (meant for isolated coincidences, not systematic drift) fail on one shut valve. Every such sample still has to pass the per-sample proximity test; an unexcused difference fails. Found with the draft harness on exploration seeds: one P42 REF vector with a transient closure gave 27 excused samples in one segment (0.98-1.09 % of the entry's discrete leaves)

documented_divergence.statement: transient integrator: the reference calls scipy solve_ivp (LSODA, or BDF for the convergence reference) with dense output at t_eval; Rust integrates with a Radau IIA order-5 method (simplified Newton on the analytic Jacobian, step-doubling error estimate with local extrapolation, error norm RMS(err / (ATOL_SCALED + rtol max(|y|, |y_new|))), steps clamped to the t_eval points, restarted at every event, failure -> R_INTEGRATOR). The 'method' argument is accepted for API parity and recorded; it does not select a Rust algorithm; v4: steps are bisected so that none integrates across a switch of the valve-command saturation state (rust_implementation.v4_rust_defect_fix); v6: no accepted step damps a growing mode of the Jacobian (the step is halved while any eigenvalue with Re lambda > 0 has |R_acc(h lambda)| < 1; rust_implementation.v6_rust_defect_fix)
